headline: Congress named a post office in Butler, Pennsylvania after Andrew Gomer Williams.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 345 South Main Street in Butler, Pennsylvania, as the Andrew Gomer Williams Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change how mail is delivered or what services the office offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the name change took effect when it was signed.
